For single\-chain proteins, [embedders\.py L39](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/embedders.py#L39) handles the target and MSA features along with relative positional encodings, converting them into MSA and pair embeddings\. For multimeric proteins, [embedders\.py L158](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/embedders.py#L158) extends this by incorporating chain\-aware relative positional encodings, considering factors like [config\.py L815](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/config.py#L815) and [config\.py L824](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/config.py#L824) to differentiate within\-chain and between\-chain relationships, thus enabling the model to understand the stoichiometry and arrangement of chains within a complex\. A [embedders\.py L313](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/embedders.py#L313) is available for scenarios where pre\-computed sequence embeddings are utilized instead of traditional MSA features\.

 Template information, crucial for leveraging known protein structures, is also integrated through specialized embedders\. The [embedders\.py L635](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/embedders.py#L635) orchestrates the embedding of template features, processing both single template features \(like predicted torsion angles\) via [embedders\.py L509](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/embedders.py#L509) and pair features \(like inter\-residue distances\) through [embedders\.py L552](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/embedders.py#L552)\. These embedded template features are then further refined by a [template\.py L358](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/template.py#L358) and [template\.py L56](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/template.py#L56) as discussed in [Template Integration and Processing](https://codewiki.google/github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold#alphafold2-model-architecture-implementation-template-integration-and-processing)\. Similar multimer\-specific versions, [embedders\.py L761](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/embedders.py#L761) and [embedders\.py L822](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/embedders.py#L822), are used for protein complexes, enriching the template data with multimer\-specific details like chain information and more precise backbone representations\. Finally, an [embedders\.py L596](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/embedders.py#L596) processes additional, unclustered MSA sequences, contributing to a more comprehensive understanding of the sequence landscape\.

 A key aspect of OpenFold's architecture is its iterative refinement process, known as recycling\. This mechanism, orchestrated within the main [model\.py L66](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/model.py#L66) class in [`openfold/model/model.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/model.py), progressively refines predictions by feeding outputs from a previous iteration back into the model\. The [embedders\.py L407](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/embedders.py#L407) in [`openfold/model/embedders.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/embedders.py) plays a central role here\. It takes the MSA, pair, and coordinate embeddings generated in the previous prediction cycle, normalizes them, and incorporates new distogram features derived from the predicted C\-beta coordinates\. These recycled embeddings, particularly the updated MSA and pair representations, are then fed into the subsequent model iteration, allowing the model to refine its understanding of the protein structure in a self\-corrective loop\. This iterative process, which can include early stopping based on RMSD differences between successive predictions as implemented in the [model\.py L186](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/model.py#L186) function, ensures that the model can progressively converge to a more accurate protein structure prediction\.### Evoformer Blocks and Stacks

![Diagram](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

The Evoformer is a central component in OpenFold, responsible for refining the Multiple Sequence Alignment \(MSA\) and pairwise residue representations\. This iterative process enhances the model's understanding of protein sequence and structural relationships\. The architecture is primarily implemented in [`openfold/model/evoformer.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/evoformer.py) and relies on a series of specialized attention mechanisms and multiplicative updates to process these representations\.

 The core of the Evoformer is built from [evoformer\.py L387](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/evoformer.py#L387) and [evoformer\.py L571](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/evoformer.py#L571) instances, which are stacked sequentially to form the [evoformer\.py L769](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/evoformer.py#L769) and [evoformer\.py L1067](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/evoformer.py#L1067) respectively\. Each block processes and updates two main tensor representations: the MSA embedding \(m\) and the pair embedding \(z\)\.

 Key components within these blocks include:

 - **MSATransition**: This component, implemented as [evoformer\.py L51](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/evoformer.py#L51) in [`openfold/model/evoformer.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/evoformer.py), applies a feed\-forward network to MSA activations, processing each row independently\.
- **PairStack**: The [evoformer\.py L126](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/evoformer.py#L126) in [`openfold/model/evoformer.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/evoformer.py) handles interactions within the pair representation\. It integrates [triangular\_multiplicative\_update\.py L561](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/triangular_multiplicative_update.py#L561) and [triangular\_multiplicative\_update\.py L568](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/triangular_multiplicative_update.py#L568) \(or their fused counterparts\), which perform multiplicative updates on the pair representation\. These operations, detailed in [`openfold/model/triangular_multiplicative_update.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/triangular_multiplicative_update.py), refine pairwise residue relationships\. Additionally, [evoformer\.py L126](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/evoformer.py#L126) uses [triangular\_attention\.py L32](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/triangular_attention.py#L32) from [`openfold/model/triangular_attention.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/triangular_attention.py) to apply triangular self\-attention to the pair representation from both starting and ending node perspectives\. A [pair\_transition\.py L24](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/pair_transition.py#L24) module, defined in [`openfold/model/pair_transition.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/pair_transition.py), further updates the pair embeddings using a three\-layer feed\-forward network\.
- **OuterProductMean**: The [outer\_product\_mean\.py L27](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/outer_product_mean.py#L27) module, specified in [`openfold/model/outer_product_mean.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/outer_product_mean.py), transforms MSA embeddings into an update for the pair embedding\. It normalizes the MSA embedding, applies linear transformations, computes an outer product, and then applies a final linear transformation, normalized by a mask product\.
- **Attention Mechanisms**: Various specialized attention modules are critical for the Evoformer\. [msa\.py L319](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/msa.py#L319) applies row\-wise MSA attention, incorporating a bias from the pair representation to inform attention scores\. [msa\.py L348](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/msa.py#L348) performs attention along the column dimension of the MSA, while [msa\.py L427](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/msa.py#L427) implements a global attention mechanism for columns\. These attention mechanisms are implemented in [`openfold/model/msa.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/msa.py)\. For further details on how these attention mechanisms and other primitive modules are implemented, refer to [Primitive Modules and Initialization Strategies](https://codewiki.google/github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold#alphafold2-model-architecture-implementation-primitive-modules-and-initialization-strategies)\.

 To manage the substantial memory requirements of these computations, particularly for large proteins, the Evoformer employs several optimization strategies\. Activation checkpointing \([checkpointing\.py L43](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/checkpointing.py#L43)\) is used in [evoformer\.py L769](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/evoformer.py#L769) and [evoformer\.py L1067](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/evoformer.py#L1067) to reduce memory footprint during training by recomputing intermediate activations rather than storing them\. Additionally, chunking mechanisms \([msa\.py L92](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/msa.py#L92)\) are widely integrated across modules like [evoformer\.py L51](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/evoformer.py#L51), [pair\_transition\.py L24](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/pair_transition.py#L24), [outer\_product\_mean\.py L27](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/outer_product_mean.py#L27), and the various attention modules, breaking down large tensor operations into smaller, more manageable parts\. Memory offloading \([model\.py L461](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/model.py#L461)\) is also implemented to move tensors between CPU and GPU, further conserving GPU memory during inference\. These memory optimization strategies are further discussed in [Memory Optimization Techniques](https://codewiki.google/github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold#alphafold2-model-architecture-implementation-memory-optimization-techniques)\.### Structure Module and Protein Folding

![Diagram](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

The Structure Module within OpenFold is responsible for translating the abstract representations generated by the Evoformer into concrete, three\-dimensional protein structures\. It operates iteratively, refining predicted atomic coordinates and backbone geometries through a series of specialized neural network components\. This module is a crucial final step in the protein structure prediction pipeline, converting high\-dimensional feature embeddings into physical protein models\.

 The core of the Structure Module's operation is an iterative process\. It takes as input a single representation, which encodes residue\-specific features, and a pair representation, capturing inter\-residue relationships\. These representations are progressively refined over several steps to produce detailed structural information\.

 Key components that facilitate this structural conversion include:

 - [structure\_module\.py L209](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/structure_module.py#L209): This mechanism, implemented in [`openfold/model/structure_module.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/structure_module.py), computes attention over invariant point objects\. It integrates information from both the single and pair representations, allowing the model to reason about spatial relationships between residues\. For multimeric proteins, a specialized [structure\_module\.py L513](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/structure_module.py#L513) is used, which incorporates features from [vector\.py L25](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/vector.py#L25) to handle multiple chains\.
- Backbone Updates: The module iteratively adjusts the protein backbone\. In monomeric contexts, this is managed by [structure\_module\.py L736](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/structure_module.py#L736), which outputs an update vector for [rigid\_utils\.py L813](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/rigid_utils.py#L813) transformations\. For multimers, [quat\_rigid\.py L10](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/quat_rigid.py#L10) handles backbone updates using quaternion\-based rigid transformations, allowing for precise control over rotational and translational movements\. These transformations are derived from objects such as [rigid\_matrix\_vector\.py L30](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rigid_matrix_vector.py#L30) from [`openfold/utils/geometry/rigid_matrix_vector.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rigid_matrix_vector.py)\.
- [structure\_module\.py L78](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/structure_module.py#L78): This component, detailed in [`openfold/model/structure_module.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/structure_module.py), predicts the torsion angles \(like phi and psi\) for each residue's backbone and side chains\. These angles are critical for defining the protein's conformation\. The predicted angles are then used to reconstruct the 3D atomic coordinates from idealized bond lengths and angles, leveraging functions like [feats\.py L185](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/feats.py#L185) and [feats\.py L253](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/feats.py#L253)\.

 The [structure\_module\.py L817](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/structure_module.py#L817) also includes components like [structure\_module\.py L766](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/structure_module.py#L766) and [structure\_module\.py L791](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/structure_module.py#L791) to further refine the single representation, along with [structure\_module\.py L164](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/structure_module.py#L164) to project single representations into local 3D points\. The module is designed with memory efficiency in mind, offering options like offloading for inference \([model\.py L461](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/model.py#L461)\) and [msa\.py L138](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/msa.py#L138) operations, which are crucial for handling large protein systems\. The result of this iterative process is a set of predicted atomic coordinates and backbone frames, representing the final folded protein structure\.### Template Integration and Processing

OpenFold integrates structural template information into its protein structure prediction pipeline to enhance accuracy\. This process involves embedding template features and refining them through specialized modules\. The core logic resides within the [model\.py L66](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/model.py#L66) class in [`openfold/model/model.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/model.py), which orchestrates the use of a [model\.py L109](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/model.py#L109) for this purpose\.

 Template embedding begins by processing raw template data, often involving the generation of specific features like pairwise distances and angular information\. This is handled by specialized embedders such as [embedders\.py L878](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/embedders.py#L878) or [embedders\.py L635](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/embedders.py#L635) in [`openfold/model/embedders.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/embedders.py), depending on whether the prediction involves multimeric protein complexes\. These embedders convert template features into high\-dimensional representations suitable for the model's architectural components\.

 After initial embedding, the template representations are refined using modules like [template\.py L358](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/template.py#L358) defined in [`openfold/model/template.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/template.py)\. This stack consists of multiple [template\.py L150](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/template.py#L150) instances, which apply operations such as triangular attention and multiplicative updates to the template pair embeddings\. These operations allow the model to capture complex relationships within the template structure and to integrate this information effectively\.

 A crucial step in incorporating template data is [template\.py L56](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/template.py#L56), also found in [`openfold/model/template.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/template.py)\. This mechanism applies attention between the model's evolving pair representation \([vector\.py L28](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/vector.py#L28)\) and the refined template embeddings\. This allows the model to selectively draw relevant structural information from the templates, guiding its own prediction towards plausible conformations suggested by existing structures\.

 For memory optimization, especially during inference with many templates or long sequences, functions like [template\.py L490](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/template.py#L490) and [template\.py L603](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/template.py#L603) \(also in [`openfold/model/template.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/template.py)\) are utilized\. These strategies either process templates individually and offload them to CPU or group and average template contributions, balancing computational cost with memory footprint\. The choice between these methods, and the overall configuration of template integration, is determined by the model's configuration \([model\.py L83](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/model.py#L83)\)\.### Primitive Modules and Initialization Strategies

![Diagram](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

OpenFold establishes fundamental neural network building blocks and initialization strategies to ensure stable and efficient model training\. The core components, such as linear layers and layer normalization, are extended to integrate custom initialization schemes and handle [build\_deepspeed\_config\.py L275](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/build_deepspeed_config.py#L275) precision for optimized performance\.

 A customized [primitives\.py L138](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/primitives.py#L138) layer, defined in [`openfold/model/primitives.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/primitives.py), serves as a versatile building block with a range of weight initialization options\. These include [utils\.py L15](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/utils.py#L15) using LeCun normal initialization, [loss\.py L853](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/loss.py#L853) for He normal initialization, and [heads\.py L112](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/heads.py#L112) for zero initialization, among others\. This flexibility allows specific initialization strategies to be applied across different parts of the network, which can be critical for training deep models effectively\. Similarly, a specialized [primitives\.py L229](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/primitives.py#L229) implementation in the same file supports [build\_deepspeed\_config\.py L275](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/build_deepspeed_config.py#L275) precision, enabling more controlled mixed\-precision training\.

 For attention mechanisms, OpenFold provides a highly configurable [primitives\.py L360](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/primitives.py#L360) module in [`openfold/model/primitives.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/primitives.py)\. This module acts as a wrapper for various high\-performance attention kernels, including DeepSpeed's optimized Evoformer attention, FlashAttention, and a custom low\-memory attention \([primitives\.py L758](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/primitives.py#L758)\)\. By abstracting these implementations, the system can leverage hardware\-specific optimizations or memory\-saving techniques without requiring changes to the model architecture itself\. This modularity allows for dynamic selection of the most efficient attention backend based on available resources and performance requirements\. The [primitives\.py L360](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/primitives.py#L360) module can also incorporate biases, such as pair bias in [Evoformer and Attention Mechanisms](https://codewiki.google/github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold#protein-structure-prediction-core-evoformer-and-attention-mechanisms), and supports an optional gating mechanism for its output\.

 Further attention variations are available for specific contexts, such as [primitives\.py L603](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/primitives.py#L603) for operations requiring global context awareness\. The framework also includes a custom [primitives\.py L267](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/primitives.py#L267) function that prevents unintended [Inference\.md?plain=1 L149](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/docs/source/Inference.md?plain=1#L149) casting for [build\_deepspeed\_config\.py L275](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/build_deepspeed_config.py#L275) inputs when DeepSpeed is not actively managing automatic mixed precision, ensuring precise control over numerical stability\. Additionally, custom dropout mechanisms, such as [dropout\.py L66](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/dropout.py#L66) and [dropout\.py L75](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/dropout.py#L75) defined in [`openfold/model/dropout.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/dropout.py), allow for sharing dropout masks along specific dimensions, which is useful for maintaining structural relationships in the data during regularization\.### Memory Optimization Techniques

| Technique | Description | Modules/Components |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chunking | Processing inputs in smaller segments to reduce peak memory\. This is widely used across the model\. | MSAAttention, MSATransition, OuterProductMean, PairTransition, TriangleAttention, TemplatePointwiseAttention, TriangleMultiplicativeUpdate |
| In\-place Operations | Modifying tensors directly rather than creating new ones, reducing memory allocations\. Crucial for inference on large inputs\. | EvoformerBlock, PairStack, MSATransition, OuterProductMean, TriangleMultiplicativeUpdate \(especially the \_inference\_forward variant\) |
| Activation Checkpointing | Storing only a subset of intermediate activations during the forward pass and recomputing them during the backward pass to save memory\. | EvoformerStack, ExtraMSAStack, TemplatePairStack, \_attention\_chunked\_trainable \(within MSAAttention\) |
| CPU Offloading | Moving large intermediate tensors to CPU memory when not actively being used on the GPU\. Primarily for very large inference tasks\. | EvoformerStack, ExtraMSAStack, AlphaFold\.iteration, embed\_templates\_offload |
| Low\-Memory Attention \(LMA\) | An attention mechanism that computes attention in a memory\-efficient manner, particularly useful for long sequences\. | Attention, MSARowAttentionWithPairBias, MSAColumnAttention, MSAColumnGlobalAttention, TemplatePointwiseAttention, TriangleAttention |
| FlashAttention | A highly optimized attention kernel designed for speed and memory efficiency on GPUs\. | Attention, MSAColumnAttention |
| DeepSpeed Evoformer Attention | A memory\-optimized Evoformer attention kernel from DeepSpeed, offering performance benefits for certain hardware and configurations\. | Attention, MSARowAttentionWithPairBias, MSAColumnAttention, TriangleAttention |
| cuEquivariance Attention/Multiplicative Update | Specialized kernels that offer optimized performance and memory usage for attention and triangular multiplicative updates\. | Attention, TriangleMultiplicativeUpdate |
| BFloat16 Precision | Using bfloat16 for computations can reduce memory footprint and increase speed, with minimal impact on accuracy\. | Linear, LayerNorm, softmax\_no\_cast |

OpenFold employs several strategies to manage memory consumption, which is particularly relevant when processing large protein systems or long sequences\. These strategies include chunking, activation checkpointing, and specialized attention mechanisms\.

 Chunking is applied in various modules to break down large tensor operations into smaller, more manageable segments\. For example, in the [outer\_product\_mean\.py L27](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/outer_product_mean.py#L27) module \([`openfold/model/outer_product_mean.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/outer_product_mean.py)\), attention calculations are chunked to reduce peak GPU memory usage during inference\. Similarly, the [msa\.py L38](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/msa.py#L38) \([`openfold/model/msa.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/msa.py)\) and [triangular\_attention\.py L32](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/triangular_attention.py#L32) \([`openfold/model/triangular_attention.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/triangular_attention.py)\) modules use chunking via the [msa\.py L92](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/msa.py#L92) method to process attention calculations in parts\. The [pair\_transition\.py L24](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/pair_transition.py#L24) module \([`openfold/model/pair_transition.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/pair_transition.py)\) also uses chunking for its feed\-forward network operations to handle extensive pair representations\.

 Activation checkpointing is a technique used to trade computation time for memory reduction during training\. Instead of storing all intermediate activations for backpropagation, only a subset is stored, and others are recomputed during the backward pass\. The [evoformer\.py L769](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/evoformer.py#L769) and [evoformer\.py L1067](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/evoformer.py#L1067) \([`openfold/model/evoformer.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/evoformer.py)\) extensively use activation checkpointing to manage the memory footprint of stacked Evoformer blocks\.

 The [model\.py L66](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/model.py#L66) model \([`openfold/model/model.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/model.py)\) integrates memory offloading, moving tensors between CPU and GPU to conserve GPU memory during inference, particularly for large models\. This is managed by [evoformer\.py L941](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/evoformer.py#L941) methods on components like the [config\.py L253](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/config.py#L253) and [config\.py L1010](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/config.py#L1010)\.

 The [primitives\.py L360](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/primitives.py#L360) primitive \([`openfold/model/primitives.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/primitives.py)\) supports multiple attention backends, including optimized kernels from external libraries and a custom low\-memory attention \([primitives\.py L758](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/primitives.py#L758)\)\. These implementations are designed to improve performance and reduce memory usage compared to standard PyTorch attention\.

 The [triangular\_multiplicative\_update\.py L177](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/triangular_multiplicative_update.py#L177) module \([`openfold/model/triangular_multiplicative_update.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/triangular_multiplicative_update.py)\) implements an optimized inference mode \([triangular\_multiplicative\_update\.py L198](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/triangular_multiplicative_update.py#L198)\) that reduces peak memory consumption through in\-place operations, chunking, and a [triangular\_multiplicative\_update\.py L336](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/triangular_multiplicative_update.py#L336) mechanism\. This is particularly relevant for long sequences, where it can significantly reduce memory requirements\. The module also integrates with [config\.py L74](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/config.py#L74) for additional performance acceleration\.

 In multimer scenarios, the [model\.py L66](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/model.py#L66) model provides [template\.py L490](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/template.py#L490) and [template\.py L603](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/template.py#L603) within its [model\.py L137](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/model.py#L137) function to handle template information efficiently \([`openfold/model/model.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/model.py)\)\. [template\.py L490](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/template.py#L490) processes templates individually and offloads them to CPU, while [template\.py L603](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/template.py#L603) groups templates and averages their contributions, trading some accuracy for a lower memory footprint\. See [Template Integration and Processing](https://codewiki.google/github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold#alphafold2-model-architecture-implementation-template-integration-and-processing) for more details\.## Protein Structure Representation and Manipulation

![Diagram](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

Protein structure representation and manipulation within OpenFold involves parsing, converting, and representing protein structures, including handling amino acid properties, 3D geometry, and transformations\. It also incorporates methods for refining protein coordinates through energy minimization\.

 The core data structure for handling protein information is the [protein\.py L45](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py#L45) dataclass, defined in [`openfold/np/protein.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py)\. This dataclass standardizes the representation of protein structures, storing atom positions, amino acid types, masks, residue indices, and B\-factors\. Utilities are provided to convert between the [protein\.py L45](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py#L45) object and common protein data formats such as PDB strings, ProteinNet strings, and ModelCIF strings\. For example, [protein\.py L89](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py#L89) parses PDB data into a [protein\.py L45](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py#L45) object, while [protein\.py L321](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py#L321) converts a [protein\.py L45](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py#L45) object back into a PDB formatted string\. The [protein\.py L574](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py#L574) function can generate standard atom masks based on heavy atoms for each amino acid type\.

 For refining predicted protein coordinates, OpenFold incorporates Amber energy minimization\. This iterative, restrained process is managed by the [relax\.py L23](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/relax.py#L23) class in [`openfold/np/relax/relax.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/relax.py)\. The relaxation pipeline, implemented in [`openfold/np/relax/amber_minimize.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/amber_minimize.py), uses OpenMM to perform energy minimization, applying harmonic positional restraints to guide the protein towards a relaxed state while preserving its overall fold\. This process includes cleaning PDB files using utilities in [`openfold/np/relax/cleanup.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/cleanup.py) and detecting structural violations to inform subsequent minimization rounds\. Utility functions in [`openfold/np/relax/utils.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/utils.py) support manipulating PDB strings for coordinate and B\-factor updates\.

 Amino acid properties and stereochemical information are centralized in [`openfold/np/residue_constants.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py)\. This file stores constants and utility functions related to amino acid types, atomic structures, and bond geometries\. It includes functionalities to load stereochemical properties, convert sequences to one\-hot encodings, and precompute mappings and masks for efficient manipulation of atomic data\. This allows for transformations between different atom representations, such as the 37\-atom and 14\-atom representations, and aids in handling symmetrical atoms\.

 OpenFold manages 3D geometry, rotations, and rigid transformations using [msa\.py L93](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/msa.py#L93)s\. This functionality is primarily located in [`openfold/utils/geometry`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry)\. Key data structures include [vector\.py L25](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/vector.py#L25) for 3D vectors \([`openfold/utils/geometry/vector.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/vector.py)\), [rotation\_matrix\.py L30](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rotation_matrix.py#L30) for 3x3 rotation matrices \([`openfold/utils/geometry/rotation_matrix.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rotation_matrix.py)\), and [rigid\_matrix\_vector\.py L30](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rigid_matrix_vector.py#L30) for rigid transformations, which combine rotation and translation \([`openfold/utils/geometry/rigid_matrix_vector.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rigid_matrix_vector.py)\)\. These classes support common geometric operations such as composition, inversion, and applying transformations to points, optimized for batched tensor computations\. The [quat\_rigid\.py L10](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/quat_rigid.py#L10) module in [`openfold/utils/geometry/quat_rigid.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/quat_rigid.py) converts neural network activations into [rigid\_matrix\_vector\.py L30](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rigid_matrix_vector.py#L30) transformations using quaternions, offering a compact representation for rotations\. These geometric utilities are fundamental for handling the 3D coordinates and orientations of proteins within the model\.### Protein Data Representation and Conversion

![Diagram](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

OpenFold standardizes protein data handling through the [protein\.py L45](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py#L45) dataclass, defined in [`openfold/np/protein.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py)\. This dataclass acts as a central repository for key structural information, including atomic coordinates, amino acid types, atom masks, residue indices, and B\-factors\. This standardized representation facilitates consistent processing throughout the OpenFold pipeline\.

 The system provides utilities for converting various protein data formats into this [protein\.py L45](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py#L45) object and vice\-versa\. For instance, [protein\.py L89](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py#L89) parses PDB \(Protein Data Bank\) strings, handling aspects like single models and specific chains, while [protein\.py L188](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py#L188) converts ProteinNet formatted data, extracting sequence and tertiary coordinates\. Conversions back to standard formats are supported by [protein\.py L321](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py#L321), which generates PDB formatted strings, and [protein\.py L446](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py#L446), which transforms [protein\.py L45](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py#L45) objects into ModelCIF formatted strings, incorporating quality metrics like pLDDT scores\.

 The [protein\.py L45](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py#L45) dataclass also includes utilities for generating ideal atom masks based on standard heavy atoms for each amino acid type and constructing [protein\.py L45](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/protein.py#L45) objects directly from model predictions\. The [train\_openfold\.py L23](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/train_openfold.py#L23) module \([`openfold/np/residue_constants.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py)\) centralizes constants and utility functions for amino acid properties, atomic structures, and bond geometry, supporting transformations and validation of protein structural data\. This module is essential for ensuring that protein structures conform to expected biophysical parameters\.### Amber Energy Minimization and Relaxation

![Diagram](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

OpenFold incorporates an iterative, restrained Amber energy minimization process to refine predicted protein coordinates\. This process, primarily managed within the [`openfold/np/relax`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax) directory, uses OpenMM for molecular dynamics simulations\. The central component for this operation is the [relax\.py L23](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/relax.py#L23) class, which orchestrates the refinement of protein structures\.

 The [relax\.py L23](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/relax.py#L23) class in [`openfold/np/relax/relax.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/relax.py) serves as the primary interface\. It can be configured with parameters such as maximum iterations, energy tolerance, and stiffness for positional restraints\. The [relax\.py L59](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/relax.py#L59) method of this class takes a [relax\.py L60](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/relax.py#L60) object as input and returns a refined PDB or ModelCIF string\. This method relies on the [amber\_minimize\.py L475](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/amber_minimize.py#L475) function within [`openfold/np/relax/amber_minimize.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/amber_minimize.py) to execute the core minimization logic\.

 Before minimization, protein structures undergo a cleanup phase using utilities in [`openfold/np/relax/cleanup.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/cleanup.py)\. This step addresses common issues in PDB files by leveraging [environment\.yml L14](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/environment.yml#L14) to correct nonstandard residues, remove heterogens, and add missing atoms or hydrogens\. Custom fixes are also applied to standardize structures, ensuring compatibility with OpenMM\.

 During the iterative minimization process, harmonic positional restraints are applied to guide the relaxation\. These restraints prevent the protein from deviating too far from its initial predicted conformation while allowing local adjustments\. The [amber\_minimize\.py L50](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/amber_minimize.py#L50) function in [`openfold/np/relax/amber_minimize.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/amber_minimize.py) implements this by applying [amber\_minimize\.py L60](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/amber_minimize.py#L60) to specific atoms, such as non\-hydrogen atoms or alpha\-carbons\.

 After each minimization step, structural violations \(e\.g\., clashes, bond length deviations\) are detected\. The [amber\_minimize\.py L399](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/amber_minimize.py#L399) function in [`openfold/np/relax/amber_minimize.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/amber_minimize.py) identifies these issues and can update a list of [config\.py L723](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/config.py#L723)\. This iterative approach aims to resolve structural problems over multiple rounds, selectively relaxing regions while maintaining the overall protein fold\. Utilities in [`openfold/np/relax/utils.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/relax/utils.py) are used to update PDB strings with minimized coordinates and B\-factors, and to validate atom types post\-minimization\.### Amino Acid Properties and Stereochemistry

| Constant/Mapping Name | Purpose | Data Type/Content |
| --- | --- | --- |
| chi\_angles\_atoms | Defines the atoms involved in each chi angle for each amino acid\. | Mapping\[str, List\[List\[str\]\]\] |
| chi\_angles\_mask | Mask indicating which chi angles are present for each amino acid type\. | List\[List\[float\]\] \(NumPy array\) |
| chi\_pi\_periodic | Indicates which chi angles are pi periodic for each amino acid type\. | List\[List\[float\]\] \(NumPy array\) |
| rigid\_group\_atom\_positions | Defines the relative positions of atoms within rigid groups for each amino acid\. | Mapping\[str, List\[List\[Union\[str, int, Tuple\[float, float, float\]\]\]\]\] |
| residue\_atoms | Lists all non\-hydrogen atoms for each amino acid type using PDB naming\. | Mapping\[str, List\[str\]\] |
| residue\_atom\_renaming\_swaps | Specifies ambiguous atom names for certain amino acids due to symmetry\. | Mapping\[str, Mapping\[str, str\]\] |
| van\_der\_waals\_radius | Van der Waals radii for common atom types\. | Mapping\[str, float\] |
| load\_stereo\_chemical\_props | Function to load and process stereochemical properties \(bond lengths, angles, virtual bonds\)\. | Returns Tuple\[Mapping, Mapping, Mapping\] of Bond and BondAngle namedtuples\. |
| atom\_types, atom\_order, atom\_type\_num | Standardized lists and mappings for all possible atom types\. | List\[str\], Mapping\[str, int\], int |
| restype\_name\_to\_atom14\_names | Maps residue names to a fixed\-size list of 14 atom names for compact representation\. | Mapping\[str, List\[str\]\] |
| restypes, restype\_order, restype\_num | Standardized lists and mappings for the 20 common amino acid types\. | List\[str\], Mapping\[str, int\], int |
| restype\_1to3, restype\_3to1 | Mappings between one\-letter and three\-letter amino acid codes\. | Mapping\[str, str\] |
| HHBLITS\_AA\_TO\_ID, ID\_TO\_HHBLITS\_AA | Mappings between amino acid codes and integer IDs, following HHblits conventions\. | Mapping\[str, int\], Mapping\[int, str\] |

The representation and manipulation of amino acid properties and stereochemical information are centralized within OpenFold\. This includes data for all standard amino acid types and an "UNK" type for unknown residues\. A variety of constants and mappings are precomputed and stored as global variables to enhance performance by minimizing runtime computations\. These static values, such as [residue\_constants\.py L82](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py#L82), [residue\_constants\.py L877](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py#L877), and [residue\_constants\.py L595](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py#L595), define the structural characteristics of amino acids\.

 The [residue\_constants\.py L440](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py#L440) function in [`openfold/np/residue_constants.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py) reads stereochemical properties, including bond lengths and angles, from an external text file\. This data is then processed to generate "virtual bonds," which represent distances between non\-bonded atoms whose positions are constrained by bond angles\. The Law of Cosines is employed to calculate these virtual bond lengths, and the function also accounts for the propagation of uncertainty from measured bond lengths and angles to their virtual counterparts\. The outputs of this process, such as [residue\_constants\.py L452](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py#L452), [residue\_constants\.py L449](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py#L449), and [residue\_constants\.py L454](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py#L454), provide a detailed geometric description of each residue\.

 OpenFold uses two primary atom representations: a 37\-atom general representation and a more compact 14\-atom representation\. This dual representation offers flexibility and optimization, allowing the model to use the compact form when fine\-grained side\-chain details are not critical\. Functions such as [residue\_constants\.py L1134](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py#L1134) and [residue\_constants\.py L1315](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py#L1315) initialize global NumPy arrays that store mappings and relative positions for atoms within different rigid groups of each residue type\. These arrays are crucial for geometric calculations and defining the relative orientations of rigid groups within a residue\.

 For specific residues with symmetrical atoms \(e\.g\., ASP, GLU, PHE, TYR\), the [residue\_constants\.py L1288](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py#L1288) function addresses the ambiguity in atom naming by populating [residue\_constants\.py L1282](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py#L1282) and [residue\_constants\.py L1283](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py#L1283)\. This mechanism handles cases where atoms can be swapped without altering the chemical structure, ensuring accurate representation\.

 The system also provides specialized functions like [residue\_constants\.py L885](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py#L885) for converting amino acid sequences into one\-hot encoded NumPy arrays and [residue\_constants\.py L1307](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py#L1307) for converting amino acid type IDs back into string sequences\. Furthermore, mappings like [residue\_constants\.py L975](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py#L975) are included to align with the amino acid encoding conventions of external bioinformatics tools such as HHblits\. These functionalities are centralized in [`openfold/np/residue_constants.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/np/residue_constants.py), ensuring consistent handling of amino acid data across the OpenFold framework\. For a broader understanding of how protein data is generally represented and converted, see [Protein Data Representation and Conversion](https://codewiki.google/github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold#protein-structure-representation-and-manipulation-protein-data-representation-and-conversion)\.### 3D Geometry, Rotations, and Rigid Transformations

![Diagram](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

OpenFold provides a set of utilities for representing and manipulating 3D geometric data within PyTorch tensors, which is fundamental for protein structure prediction\. These utilities focus on 3D vectors, rotation matrices, and rigid transformations\.

 The [vector\.py L25](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/vector.py#L25) dataclass, defined in [`openfold/utils/geometry/vector.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/vector.py), stores 3D vectors using [msa\.py L93](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/msa.py#L93) components\. It supports common vector operations like addition, subtraction, scalar multiplication, dot products, and cross products\. It also includes methods for calculating vector norms and normalization, and utility functions for computing Euclidean distances and dihedral angles between [vector\.py L25](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/vector.py#L25) instances\.

 For 3D rotations, the [rotation\_matrix\.py L30](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rotation_matrix.py#L30) dataclass in [`openfold/utils/geometry/rotation_matrix.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rotation_matrix.py) uses a struct\-of\-arrays approach, where each component of a 3x3 rotation matrix is stored as a separate [msa\.py L93](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/msa.py#L93)\. This design supports matrix multiplication, inversion \(transposition\), and applying rotations to 3D points\. It also includes methods to construct rotations from quaternions or from two vectors\.

 The [rigid\_matrix\_vector\.py L30](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rigid_matrix_vector.py#L30) dataclass, found in [`openfold/utils/geometry/rigid_matrix_vector.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rigid_matrix_vector.py), combines [rotation\_matrix\.py L30](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rotation_matrix.py#L30) for rotation and [vector\.py L25](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/vector.py#L25) for translation to represent 3D rigid transformations\. It enables operations such as transformation composition, inversion, and the application of transformations to 3D points\. The [rigid\_matrix\_vector\.py L30](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rigid_matrix_vector.py#L30) also facilitates conversions to and from standard 4x4 homogeneous [msa\.py L93](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/msa.py#L93) representations, allowing interoperability with other geometric libraries\.

 OpenFold also integrates neural network predictions with these geometric representations through the [quat\_rigid\.py L10](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/quat_rigid.py#L10) module in [`openfold/utils/geometry/quat_rigid.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/quat_rigid.py)\. This [torchscript\.py L51](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/torchscript.py#L51) converts neural network activations into [rigid\_matrix\_vector\.py L30](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rigid_matrix_vector.py#L30) transformations, using quaternions to represent rotations\. This allows the model to predict structural changes directly from learned features\.

 These core data structures and their associated operations are aggregated and exposed through [`openfold/utils/geometry/__init__.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/__init__.py), providing a unified interface for geometric computations across the OpenFold codebase\. The framework also includes testing utilities in [`openfold/utils/geometry/test_utils.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/test_utils.py) to ensure the correctness of these geometric operations\. More general utility functions for protein structural and coordinate transformations are discussed in [Protein Structural and Coordinate Transformations](https://codewiki.google/github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold#openfold-utility-functions-and-performance-optimization-protein-structural-and-coordinate-transformations)\.## OpenFold Utility Functions and Performance Optimization

![Diagram](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

OpenFold provides utilities that facilitate protein structure prediction, from manipulating atomic coordinates to optimizing model performance\. These utilities broadly cover structural transformations, feature generation, and performance enhancement through techniques like TensorRT integration, mixed\-precision training, activation checkpointing, chunking, and custom CUDA kernels for attention operations\.

 A set of functions in [`openfold/utils`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils) handles protein structural and coordinate transformations\. For instance, [feats\.py L56](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/feats.py#L56) and [all\_atom\_multimer\.py L58](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/all_atom_multimer.py#L58) in [`openfold/utils/all_atom_multimer.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/all_atom_multimer.py) convert between different atom representations\. Functions such as [data\_transforms\.py L795](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/data/data_transforms.py#L795) compute rigid body frames from atomic positions, while [feats\.py L185](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/feats.py#L185) and [feats\.py L253](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/feats.py#L253) reconstruct atomic positions from torsion angles and frames\. The [all\_atom\_multimer\.py L369](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/all_atom_multimer.py#L369) function calculates chi torsion angles\. Additionally, helper functions in [`openfold/utils/feats.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/feats.py) generate pseudo\-beta atom coordinates with [feats\.py L35](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/feats.py#L35) and construct template\-specific angle and pair features\. Inter\-residue distanceograms are generated by [feats\.py L93](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/feats.py#L93), and [feats\.py L175](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/feats.py#L175) processes extra multiple sequence alignment data\. For further details on these transformations, refer to [Protein Structural and Coordinate Transformations](https://codewiki.google/github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold#openfold-utility-functions-and-performance-optimization-protein-structural-and-coordinate-transformations)\.

 The system also includes core 3D geometric data structures and operations, defined in [`openfold/utils/geometry`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry)\. This includes [vector\.py L25](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/vector.py#L25) for 3D vectors in [`openfold/utils/geometry/vector.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/vector.py), [rotation\_matrix\.py L30](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rotation_matrix.py#L30) for 3x3 rotation matrices in [`openfold/utils/geometry/rotation_matrix.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rotation_matrix.py), and [rigid\_matrix\_vector\.py L30](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rigid_matrix_vector.py#L30) for rigid transformations, which combine rotation and translation, in [`openfold/utils/geometry/rigid_matrix_vector.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rigid_matrix_vector.py)\. These structures support operations like composition, inversion, and point application, enabling efficient manipulation of 3D spatial data\. The [quat\_rigid\.py L10](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/quat_rigid.py#L10) module in [`openfold/utils/geometry/quat_rigid.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/quat_rigid.py) converts neural network activations into [rigid\_matrix\_vector\.py L30](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/geometry/rigid_matrix_vector.py#L30) transformations\. More information can be found in [Advanced 3D Geometric Data Structures and Operations](https://codewiki.google/github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold#openfold-utility-functions-and-performance-optimization-advanced-3d-geometric-data-structures-and-operations)\.

 The [loss\.py L1685](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/loss.py#L1685) class in [`openfold/utils/loss.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/loss.py) orchestrates a range of loss functions tailored for protein structure prediction, such as FAPE \(Frame Aligned Point Error\) for structural alignment, lDDT and TM\-score for structural similarity, and losses for handling structural violations \(bond, clash, and residue violations\)\. This module also includes loss terms for experimentally resolved atoms and masked MSA prediction, as well as a chain center\-of\-mass loss for multimer predictions\. The [loss\.py L1463](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/loss.py#L1463) function in this module addresses ambiguities in ground truth data arising from symmetric atoms, ensuring robust error calculations\. For a comprehensive overview of these loss functions, see [Comprehensive Loss Functions for Structure Prediction](https://codewiki.google/github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold#openfold-utility-functions-and-performance-optimization-comprehensive-loss-functions-for-structure-prediction)\.

 Performance optimization is addressed through several mechanisms\. Custom CUDA kernels for attention operations are provided in [`openfold/utils/kernel`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/kernel)\. The [attention\_core\.py L26](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/kernel/attention_core.py#L26) in [`openfold/utils/kernel/attention_core.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/kernel/attention_core.py) utilizes CUDA kernels from [`openfold/utils/kernel/csrc/softmax_cuda_kernel.cu`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/kernel/csrc/softmax_cuda_kernel.cu) for accelerated, in\-place softmax operations during forward and backward passes\. For details, refer to [Custom CUDA Kernels for Optimized Attention](https://codewiki.google/github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold#openfold-utility-functions-and-performance-optimization-custom-cuda-kernels-for-optimized-attention)\. DeepSpeed integration is supported by [checkpointing\.py L29](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/checkpointing.py#L29) in [`openfold/utils/checkpointing.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/checkpointing.py) for distributed training and activation checkpointing, which helps manage memory\. The [checkpointing\.py L43](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/checkpointing.py#L43) function groups sequential blocks for checkpointed execution\.

 Memory efficiency is further enhanced by chunking capabilities defined in [`openfold/utils/chunk_utils.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/chunk_utils.py)\. The [chunk\_utils\.py L213](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/chunk_utils.py#L213) function processes large tensors in smaller segments to reduce memory usage, particularly during inference\. The [chunk\_utils\.py L345](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/chunk_utils.py#L345) dynamically determines optimal chunk sizes to balance performance and memory constraints\. For general tensor operations, [`openfold/utils/tensor_utils.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/tensor_utils.py) provides functions like [tensor\_utils\.py L24](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/tensor_utils.py#L24), [tensor\_utils\.py L38](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/tensor_utils.py#L38), [tensor\_utils\.py L48](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/tensor_utils.py#L48), and [tensor\_utils\.py L83](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/tensor_utils.py#L83)\. Additional utilities for feature generation, such as [feats\.py L35](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/feats.py#L35), [feats\.py L69](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/feats.py#L69), [feats\.py L110](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/feats.py#L110), and [feats\.py L175](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/feats.py#L175) are also located in [`openfold/utils/tensor_utils.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/tensor_utils.py)\. More information on these capabilities can be found in [Advanced Tensor Utilities and Feature Generation](https://codewiki.google/github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold#openfold-utility-functions-and-performance-optimization-advanced-tensor-utilities-and-feature-generation)\.

 For inference acceleration, OpenFold integrates with NVIDIA TensorRT\. The [tensorrt\_lazy\_compiler\.py L382](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/tensorrt_lazy_compiler.py#L382) and [tensorrt\_lazy\_compiler\.py L127](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/tensorrt_lazy_compiler.py#L127) in [`openfold/utils/tensorrt_lazy_compiler.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/tensorrt_lazy_compiler.py) enable lazy compilation of PyTorch models into optimized TensorRT engines\. This integration supports dynamic input shapes, precision control, and fallback mechanisms, and is instrumented for components like the Evoformer in [`openfold/utils/tensorrt_utils.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/tensorrt_utils.py)\. See [TensorRT Integration for Inference Acceleration](https://codewiki.google/github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold#openfold-utility-functions-and-performance-optimization-tensorrt-integration-for-inference-acceleration) for further details\.

 The framework also provides utilities for multi\-chain permutation alignment in [`openfold/utils/multi_chain_permutation.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/multi_chain_permutation.py)\. Functions like [multi\_chain\_permutation\.py L515](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/multi_chain_permutation.py#L515) and [multi\_chain\_permutation\.py L430](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/multi_chain_permutation.py#L430) align predicted protein chains with ground truth chains by finding optimal permutations to minimize RMSD, addressing arbitrary chain ordering in multimer predictions\. This involves identifying an anchor chain, calculating optimal transformations using [multi\_chain\_permutation\.py L35](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/multi_chain_permutation.py#L35), and performing [multi\_chain\_permutation\.py L167](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/multi_chain_permutation.py#L167)\. For additional information, refer to [Multi\-Chain Permutation Alignment](https://codewiki.google/github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold#openfold-utility-functions-and-performance-optimization-multi-chain-permutation-alignment)\.

 Additionally, the [lr\_schedulers\.py L4](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/lr_schedulers.py#L4) in [`openfold/utils/lr_schedulers.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/lr_schedulers.py) implements a learning rate schedule that mimics AlphaFold 2's linear warmup, plateau, and exponential decay\. Mixed\-precision training is managed by the [precision\_utils\.py L39](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/precision_utils.py#L39) in [`openfold/utils/precision_utils.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/precision_utils.py), which automatically casts tensors between [data\_utils\.py L44](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/tests/data_utils.py#L44), [build\_deepspeed\_config\.py L275](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/build_deepspeed_config.py#L275), and [primitives\.py L52](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/model/primitives.py#L52) to enhance performance\. The [import\_weights\.py L649](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/import_weights.py#L649) and [import\_weights\.py L703](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/import_weights.py#L703) functions in [`openfold/utils/import_weights.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/import_weights.py) facilitate importing pre\-trained model weights, handling transformations and compatibility between different weight formats\.### Protein Structural and Coordinate Transformations

![Diagram](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

Protein structure prediction models require extensive manipulation of 3D coordinates and structural information\. Utility functions are provided for parsing, converting, and transforming protein data\.
