The script [`scripts/generate_alphafold_feature_dict.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/generate_alphafold_feature_dict.py) orchestrates this process\. It takes raw inputs, such as FASTA sequences, and leverages other components to perform template searching\. It also employs featurizers to convert search hits into numerical features\. For multimodal inputs, it uses data pipelines to produce the final [generate\_alphafold\_feature\_dict\.py L66](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/generate_alphafold_feature_dict.py#L66) files, which can support both monomer and multimer predictions\.

 Another set of scripts focuses on creating caches of protein chain data and mmCIF metadata\. The [`scripts/generate_chain_data_cache.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/generate_chain_data_cache.py) script builds a JSON cache containing information such as release dates, sequences, resolutions, and cluster sizes for protein chains\. It processes directories of mmCIF or PDB files, parsing each file to extract relevant chain\-specific details\. Similarly, [`scripts/generate_mmcif_cache.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/generate_mmcif_cache.py) parses mmCIF files from a specified directory to extract metadata like release dates, resolutions, and chain sequences, storing this information in a JSON cache\. Both scripts utilize parallel processing to efficiently handle large datasets\. These caches streamline data access and reduce redundant parsing during model training and evaluation by providing quick lookups for protein characteristics\.### DeepSpeed Configuration and Inference Utilities

![Diagram](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

OpenFold provides utilities for integrating DeepSpeed into its training and inference workflows\. The script [`scripts/build_deepspeed_config.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/build_deepspeed_config.py) generates DeepSpeed configuration files in JSON format\. This script enables the dynamic customization of various DeepSpeed features, including optimizer settings, learning rate schedulers, and precision training modes \(e\.g\., FP16, Bfloat16, AMP\)\. It also supports advanced optimizations like activation checkpointing and ZeRO optimization, which are critical for managing memory and scaling training to very large models\.

 For verifying DeepSpeed's inference capabilities, [`scripts/deepspeed_inference_test.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/deepspeed_inference_test.py) offers a testing framework\. This script creates a dummy model and dataset to simulate a typical inference workload, then initializes DeepSpeed inference to demonstrate how models can be parallelized and optimized across multiple GPUs\. This allows developers to confirm DeepSpeed's functionality and performance benefits in an inference setting, ensuring that deployed models can leverage these optimizations for efficient execution\.### Checkpoint Conversion Utilities

![Diagram](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

OpenFold includes utilities to convert model checkpoints between different formats, primarily to ensure compatibility with external tools and to manage versioning\. This facilitates interoperability with DeepMind's original AlphaFold JAX framework and supports ongoing development within OpenFold\.

 One set of scripts is dedicated to converting OpenFold checkpoints from the PyTorch [thread\_sequence\.py L141](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/thread_sequence.py#L141) format to AlphaFold's NumPy\-based [train\_openfold\.py L584](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/train_openfold.py#L584) format\. The script [`scripts/convert_of_weights_to_jax.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/convert_of_weights_to_jax.py) handles this conversion by loading an OpenFold [thread\_sequence\.py L141](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/thread_sequence.py#L141) checkpoint and an AlphaFold [train\_openfold\.py L584](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/train_openfold.py#L584) template\. It then meticulously translates and reshapes parameters, such as linear layer weights and multi\-head attention components, to match the AlphaFold JAX model's expected structure and naming conventions\. This process involves functions like [convert\_of\_weights\_to\_jax\.py L34](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/convert_of_weights_to_jax.py#L34) to adapt parameter dimensions and [convert\_of\_weights\_to\_jax\.py L52](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/convert_of_weights_to_jax.py#L52) to recursively copy and transform weights into the target [train\_openfold\.py L584](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/train_openfold.py#L584) structure\. The translation dictionary, generated by [import\_weights\.py L141](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/import_weights.py#L141) and processed by [import\_weights\.py L65](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/import_weights.py#L65) from [train\_openfold\.py L38](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/train_openfold.py#L38), is central to mapping OpenFold parameter names to their AlphaFold counterparts\.

 Additionally, OpenFold provides scripts to handle internal checkpoint versioning\. The [`scripts/convert_v1_to_v2_weights.py`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/convert_v1_to_v2_weights.py) script updates older OpenFold checkpoints from a deprecated V1 key format to a V2 format\. This is important for maintaining forward compatibility as the OpenFold codebase evolves\. The script can process both standard PyTorch Lightning checkpoints and DeepSpeed checkpoints, which involve specific handling for distributed training metadata such as [convert\_v1\_to\_v2\_weights\.py L68](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/convert_v1_to_v2_weights.py#L68) and optimizer states\. The core conversion logic is encapsulated in the [import\_weights\.py L671](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/utils/import_weights.py#L671) function, ensuring that internal model states are properly aligned with the current codebase\.### SLURM\-based Uniclust30 Alignment Generation

![Diagram](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

The [run\_uniclust30\_search\.sh L9](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/slurm_scripts/run_uniclust30_search.sh#L9) script, located in [`scripts/slurm_scripts`](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/slurm_scripts), orchestrates the generation of all\-against\-all Uniclust30 alignments within a SLURM high\-performance computing environment\. This process is essential for creating comprehensive multiple sequence alignments \(MSAs\) that serve as crucial input for protein structure prediction models like OpenFold\.

 The script manages the entire workflow, from preparing the necessary databases to executing parallel alignment searches and archiving results\. It begins by validating required inputs and setting up node\-specific scratch directories for efficient processing\. A key step involves transferring the [flatten\_roda\.sh L7](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/scripts/flatten_roda.sh#L7) database files to a local SSD on each compute node\. This reduces I/O latency and significantly accelerates the [hhblits\.py L30](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/data/tools/hhblits.py#L30) search operations\.

 To avoid redundant computations, the script filters already\-searched entries by checking existing output archives, ensuring that [hhblits\.py L30](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/data/tools/hhblits.py#L30) only processes new or incomplete alignment tasks\. It then splits the input data, distributing distinct subsets of proteins to individual SLURM nodes\.

 The core of the script involves parallel execution of [hhblits\.py L30](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/data/tools/hhblits.py#L30), a homology search tool\. It utilizes a semaphore mechanism to control the number of concurrent [hhblits\.py L30](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/data/tools/hhblits.py#L30) instances, efficiently leveraging the computational resources of each node\. Each [hhblits\.py L30](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/openfold/data/tools/hhblits.py#L30) process generates an A3M file, representing the MSA for a specific protein\.

 Finally, the script manages the output by periodically checking the size of the scratch directory\. Once a certain threshold is met, it compresses the generated alignments into [OpenFold\.ipynb L807](https://github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold/blob/be2ec1841f16c966c65ae0e7599ebbadc725757d/notebooks/OpenFold.ipynb#L807) archives within a designated output directory and cleans up the temporary scratch space\. This ensures efficient storage and retrieval of the extensive alignment data produced by the all\-against\-all search\. For further details on managing alignment databases, refer to [Alignment Database Creation and Management](https://codewiki.google/github.com/aqlaboratory/openfold#openfold-scripts-and-database-management-alignment-database-creation-and-management)\.
